item.title: Kamisama choose! Sensei Onna no Ko Niatteru Yo!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: KUMANOMI SOFTWARE
  • 発売日: 2025-05-30
  • スコア: 6.88/10 (122 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 神様ちゅ～ず！ センセー女の子似合ってるよっ！
  • 英語名: Kamisama choose! Sensei Onna no Ko Niatteru Yo!

あらすじ

“I’m an angel. A real one.”

The pretty, pale-skinned crossdresser, “Shirahato Inori,” said that.

Floating next to him was a plushie-like creature he called “God.”

Inori made money as an “angel” by granting wishes with God’s power.

But to grant those wishes, he had to have sex with men and offer up the semen they pumped out inside him to God.
